page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The instance demonstrates weak single-core CPU performance in stress-ng and poor single-threaded execution in Geekbench and gzip compression tests. However, multi-core benchmarks, including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, fall within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also register average performance, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is its lower single-threaded processing speed compared to its multi-threaded capacity. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers high memory density per vCPU, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require intensive single-core compute power. Appropriate workloads include database operations, Redis caching, multi-threaded text and image processing, and moderate software compilation tasks.
